5ffb2466c040a1214579fd15762b682e948dab7b.summary: Microsoft Security Intelligence's malware encyclopedia entry for TrojanDownloader:Win32/Banload, a family of Trojans that download other malware. The downloaded malware are usually members of the Win32/Banker family, which steal banking credentials and other sensitive data and send it back to a remote attacker. Detected by Microsoft Defender Antivirus. The entry was published in 2008, updated in 2017, and archived in 2026. The page lists aliases from other vendors.

5f483228d8e542273e3fe8a35b02aa8a0713825b.summary: ClearSky Cyber Security reports an Iranian "Dream Job" campaign, active since at least September 2023, in which the threat actor TA455 targeted the aerospace industry with fake job offers. The campaign distributed SnailResin malware, which activates the SlugResin backdoor. ClearSky attributes both to a subgroup of Charming Kitten, while some other research companies link the malware files to the North Korean Kimsuky/Lazarus APT group. Victims receive a ZIP file through fake recruiting websites and LinkedIn profiles.
